tolerance.label: Convergence Tolerance
tolerance.description: Max power mismatch (p.u.) for convergence. Smaller = more precise. Leave empty to use the model's value or the solver default.

max_outerloop_iterations.label: Max Outerloop Iterations
max_outerloop_iterations.description: Max iterations for reactive power and voltage control loop.

tap_adjustment.label: Tap Adjustment
tap_adjustment.description: Controls how transformer tap ratios are adjusted during the outerloop.

phase_shift_adjustment.label: Phase Shift Adjustment
phase_shift_adjustment.description: Enable automatic control of phase-shifting transformers.

dc_tap_adjustment.label: DC Tap Adjustment
dc_tap_adjustment.description: Enable tap adjustment for classic 2-terminal DC lines.

switched_shunt_adjustment.label: Switched Shunt Adjustment
switched_shunt_adjustment.description: Controls which switched shunts are allowed to adjust during the solve.

area_interchange_adjustment.label: Area Interchange Adjustment
area_interchange_adjustment.description: Adjusts each area's swing generator to meet its scheduled net interchange. Disabled by default.
